name: aqg-test-quality-review
description: Use when reviewing whether a PR's tests assert BEHAVIOR (output / side-effects / errors) or only SHAPE (types / structure / key presence), when checking whether a diff weakened, deleted or skipped tests, for coverage gaps where source changed with no paired test, for flaky patterns (sleep / wall-clock / unseeded random / live network), or for anti-horizontal-slicing review. Reviews test-QUALITY of a git diff, not coverage %. Signal only — emits a structured test-quality ledger, per-concern focus prompts, and a `needs_llm_judgement` signal; the caller runs `/audit` per concern at the depth `docs/policies/audit-trigger.md` selects. Complements aqg-multi-review (deeper than its edge_cases dimension) and aqg-code-construction (construction-side TDD). Not a test runner or coverage-percentage gate. Does not replace the host built-in /review slash command.

sentence_patterns: review the test quality of this PR / diff
are these tests actually testing behavior or just the shape of the data structures?
did this diff weaken / delete / skip any tests?
check this PR for flaky tests and coverage gaps
is this test just asserting isinstance instead of real behavior?
run aqg-test-quality-review on my branch diff

cli_contract.0: success — `analyze` printed ledger OR `validate` ledger valid
cli_contract.1: validation failure — `validate` found schema / disposition violations in ledger
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args / unknown subcommand / missing --file
cli_contract.3: reserved — config or schema error (not currently emitted)
cli_contract.70: reserved — internal error placeholder for future use

owner_only_actions: Production / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates; this skill is read-only — it parses a diff and emits a test-quality ledger + focus prompts, never modifies tests/source, never runs the suite, and never calls audit-mcp (the caller runs /audit per ADR 2026-05-08-aqg-skill-distribution-boundary-a1.md §5)

cases.prompt: review the test quality of this PR — are the tests testing behavior or just the shape of the data?
did this diff weaken, delete, or skip any tests to make CI green?
check this PR for flaky tests and coverage gaps before I merge
this test just asserts isinstance(result, dict) — is it really testing behavior?
run /aqg-test-quality-review analyze on my branch diff and give me the ledger + focus prompts
